summary.intent: Plan and execute Phase 58 (`ipns-signature-verify-coverage`) of CipherBox using the GSD workflow: research → plan → verify → execute, with `--chain` auto-advancing from planning into execution.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (4 plans, 2 waves, 0 blockers, HARD-09 covered, all D-01..D-13 addressed). Execution started but plan 58-01 died mid-way due to an API socket error; a continuation agent was spawned but the transcript ends before confirmation.

repo: Phase 58 uses TDD mode + fine granularity with locked decisions D-01..D-13 and requirement HARD-09.
Dependency cycle constraint: `crates/crypto` cannot dev-depend on `api-client`/`core`, so the cross-language Rust test vectors live in `crates/fuse/tests/` instead of `crates/crypto/tests/`.
`resolve_ipns_verified` in `crates/fuse/src/verify.rs` is the new safe-by-default IPNS verification chokepoint; 8–9 FUSE resolve sites route through it.
CBOR cid/sequence binding uses `ciborium`/`cborg` added to `crates/core`; the decode helper was built RED→GREEN per TDD.
Local stack (redis:6380, api:3000, postgres, ipfs/kubo) was confirmed up, enabling plan 58-02's full-SDK-E2E gate to actually run.
Feature branch is `feat/ipns-signature-verify-coverage`; AUTO_MODE=true so checkpoints self-handle.

code.finding: New file: wrapper around `resolve_ipns_verified` chokepoint; imports `ciborium` which required an explicit dep in `crates/fuse/Cargo.toml`.
`ciborium` dependency added here; executor diagnostic initially flagged it as missing but it was already committed.

workflow: GSD `commit_failed` return from the commit helper is a known false negative — always verify with `git log` rather than retrying the commit.
RESEARCH.md `## Open Questions` section must be marked `(RESOLVED)` after planning; plan checker flags the absence as a cosmetic warning even when questions are substantively addressed in-plan.
For security/crypto phases, sequential on-branch execution is safer than parallel-worktree: avoids cwd-drift, merge conflicts, and stranded worktrees flagged by project memory.
VALIDATION.md (Nyquist gate) must be written before planning when Nyquist is enabled; frontmatter is filled from template, body scaffold is owned by execute/validate tooling.
Pattern mapper (`gsd-pattern-mapper`) produces `PATTERNS.md` before the planner runs; output feeds planner context.

friction: 58-01 executor died mid-task-4 due to API socket error (connection closed), losing its completion signal after 4 committed tasks and leaving Task 3 uncommitted and Task 4 unstarted.
`commit_failed` false negatives from the GSD commit helper require a redundant `git log` verification step after every commit.
Executor's stale diagnostic falsely reported `ciborium` missing from `crates/fuse` after it had already been committed, causing unnecessary investigation.
